change.automation_yaml:
- id: '1777600000000'
  alias: Sleep JITAI - Afternoon activity nudge
  description: >-
    sleep-jitai | created=2026-05-01 | review_after=2026-05-15 |
    target=minutes_asleep | direction=increase |
    hypothesis=A walk on low-step afternoons may raise steps and sleep duration. |
    evidence=steps to minutes_asleep, n=29, split-half passed, confirmed 2026-04-30
  mode: single
  max_exceeded: silent
  triggers:
    - trigger: time
      at: '17:00:00'
  conditions:
    - condition: numeric_state
      entity_id: sensor.steps
      below: 9505
    - condition: template
      alias: Once per day
      value_template: >-
        {{ this.attributes.last_triggered is none
           or (now() - this.attributes.last_triggered).total_seconds() > 43200 }}
  actions:
    - action: notify.mobile_app_phone
      data:
        title: Afternoon activity check
        message: A short walk now still counts toward today's steps.
        data:
          ttl: 3600
          priority: normal
          channel: sleep-jitai
